gpui-pre 0.3.12, Apache-2.0, registry archive SHA-256:
29DB89613527079737F53752EAB27FB65C9A7DD94979256C65A0E590C9FD34D8

The smooth_scroll curve and scheduling are backported from Ray-lea/Argus,
commit a8c1a705481cb729758041db647a7955c10efe5e,
vendor/gpui-pre/src/elements/div.rs (Apache-2.0).
https://github.com/Ray-lea/Argus/tree/a8c1a705481cb729758041db647a7955c10efe5e

Net Lights changes: shared inertia for Div and virtual ListState, explicit
clock stepping, reduced-motion support, nested event ownership, cancellation
on programmatic moves and cleanup when scroll state owners are destroyed.
Existing Windows platform/cursor fixes remain in the separate windows crate.
